subject: [PATCH 2/5] btrfs: tree-checker: reject inline refs not matching the extent type

reviews.author: Boris Burkov
reviews.summary: Approved the patch logic as compact and clever, but noted that it may be too complex. Identified potential issues with corrupted images found by fuzzing.

reviews.author: Siddharth Mishra
reviews.summary: Confirmed that the patch is intended to reject corrupted images found by fuzzing, and clarified that owner refs are only added to data extents.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Nov 04, 2026 at 11:24:15AM -0800, Boris Burkov wrote:
> > 	item 9 key (30478336 METADATA_ITEM 0) itemoff 3636 itemsize 33
> > 		refs 1 gen 13 flags TREE_BLOCK
> > 		tree block skinny level 0
> > 		(172 0x5) extent owner root 5
> > 		^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
> >
>
> I assume this was crafted manually, not via btrfs operations with
> squotas enabled, right?

Right, it is a corrupted image found by fuzzing. I did not find a way
to get an owner ref on a tree block with normal operations, the kernel
only adds owner refs to data extents.

Thanks for the review.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: Patch proposes rejecting inline refs not matching the extent type in Btrfs tree-checker.
